title: Crestline Fleet Account Closing-Month Remittance Relief
content:
Remittances a business sends in the closing month lower the late-charge rate on its Crestline Fleet Account.

| Remittances received less than one whole month before the day the charge is assessed, in total (USD) | Closing-month remittance adjustment |
|---|---|
| 2500.00 or more | minus 0.25 |
| 1000.00 to 2499.99 | minus 0.10 |
| less than 1000.00 | nothing |

The total is the sum of the remittance entries applied to the account with a date less than one whole month before the day the charge is assessed.

## Boundaries

- 999.99 received: nothing; 1000.00: minus 0.10.
- 2499.99 received: minus 0.10; 2500.00: minus 0.25.

The adjustment is in percentage points and is added to the late-charge rate, the percent charged on the day the charge is assessed; a program whose monthly late-charge percent is 0 charges nothing, whatever is added to the late-charge rate.
